narrative:
Columbiana County has 63,825 registered voters, with 58.5% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 26.9% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 14.6%, a pronounced Republican lean of 12.2 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 31.7% of registrants.
